MiniMax H3: Subspace Erasure Math & 50-Block Audio-Video Routing Why 1D steering gets outvoted by frozen prompts, the PCRR decomposition that flips it in 1x, and how it composes across blocks.0..49
STAGE 1 + 2 SHIPPED
RIGHT PCRR DISCOVERY -->
1. THE FROZEN-ANCHOR PROMPT VETO (LEGACY 1D) Prompt tokens H are encoded once and re-injected unchanged at all 50 blocks × 6 steps.
warm
daylight
skin
objects ← stays in H
H1D = H + s · v̂1D (same vector added to every row)
• Adding +noir or +claymation never removes opposing baseline cues in H. • Inside 50 self-attention blocks, untouched prompt words outvote the dial (0/5 B&W stills, 0/3 192f B&W AV, 4MP H3-Image color). • Cranking s past H3's safe shift norm (~98–100) fractures scenes into diptychs.
2. THE DIAGNOSTIC DISCOVERY (PCRR DECOMPOSITION OF W_D) Fitting multi-vector WD from centered Pole-A (Ac) to shifts Dc = Bc − Ac split algebraically into two halves:
WD = VrT diag(σi / (σi2+λ)) UrT Bc − VrT diag(σi2 / (σi2+λ)) Vr
WB (Pole-B transport): 0.4%–3.0% −PV_r,λ (Rank-8 Pole-A eraser): 97.0%–99.6%
Measured Runtime Shift Share (7 cached .pt banks):
97.0%–99.6% SUBTRACTION (−A) | ||ctx_−A|| / ||ctx_B|| = 4.2× to 10.3× | cos(ctx_D, −A) = 0.9686..0.9960
So What: Steering wasn't magically translating Pole-A words into Pole-B — it worked because it noise-canceled Pole A first. Keeping −P + adding a crisp mean push (μ̂d) runs in a 193 KB file (0 external corpus, <15 ms CPU X-Ray).
3. SHIPPED 1-SLIDER FORMULA (add_norm_matched_erasure, control_vectors.py)
ΔH = RMSMatch|s|·67.5 ( s · μ̂d − clip(s, 0, 1) · ecap · (H − h̄) VrT D Vr )
(H − h̄) Centering Subtracts prompt mean h̄ (or dataset μa for vision) so shared scaffolding & nouns survive untouched. 5/5 own vs 0/5 swapped V_r
Clamped Rank-8 Erase Projects out opposing traits (e.g. warm, daylight, wall) with D = σ2/(σ2+λ). Off for s ≤ 0; ecap bounds energy. 0 leakage · max_err 5.9e-14
Target Push & RMS Lock μ̂d uses τ=0.15 ColBERT softmax matching; output is locked strictly to |s|·67.5 RMS + per-row hold ortho. 1x: 5/5 fl2va, Base50, 4MP
4. MULTI-VECTOR STACKING EQUILIBRIUM (STAGE 1 SHIPPED, dd45600e) Naive summation causes sliders to erase peers (52-vector census) & hit H3's norm cliff. Three guardrails solve it:
1. PER-SLIDER ROS V_r^(j) ⊥ span{ μ̂_d^(k) : k ≠ j } before union (peer_ros=True) Stops noir from erasing cyberpunk's chroma (0.000 peer hit vs +70% self-cancel from naive global ortho).
2. CLAMPED UNION SVD λ_max( Σ_j min(s_j,1) P_j^ROS ) ≤ 1.0 on non-consecutive groups Fixes old linear sums that reached 6 eigenvalues > 1.0 (over-erasure / sign flip) & handles interleaved spans.
3. SMOOTH NORM KNEE soft_cap_stacked_rms (95.5 → 98.5 tanh) for distinct peers Eliminated 4.0 MP lighthouse clay+noir diptych collapse (clip 0.0726 → 0.0079, lap=437.15, 3.07s).
5. WHY IT COMPOSES CLEANLY: H3's 50-BLOCK AV BRAIN & 1x AUDIO BYPASS (STAGE 2 SHIPPED, 340e8ded) Single packed sequence [ Text | <Ref Img/Vid/Aud> | 40 Hz Audio | 24 fps Video ] inside active compiler graphs (+0 added breaks, 0 rogues across all 4 backends).
blocks.0..19 Scaffolding & Face • Lays out pose, composition, & faces. • Steering 0..19 alone does ~nothing (lap 69.31 vs 69.39 base; audio 0.0005). Keep unsteered to lock <Picture 1> ID
blocks.20..29 Visual Commit Breakout • Video diverges at block 20 (30..49 misses). • Mode 1 block_band="mid_late_20_49" cools awnings/sets while protecting face & lip-sync. 1.52× mean / 1.75× peak DINOv3 ID · 180 swaps
blocks.31..47 40 Hz Audio (~10-Blk Lag) • Audio awakens behind video to match room acoustics, speech cadence, & scene foley. • soundscape_only keeps video 3.2× quieter. Explains frozen-video cache & why visuals hit audio
block 49 Readout Sink • 0.000 text delta; FinalLayer drops text rows. • Pure final K/V readout lens. Keep dense & rotated INT8
1× Q_aud → K_txt_base (Mode 2/3) Single-Pass Stream Split (split_backend="auto_1x_kv"): Video queries read cleared+steered text; audio queries peek at original text K/V inside one pass. Stage 2 Gate 1 (fl2va 90f de_llm_slop): 26.91s vs 26.82s base (1.003×) · −23.19 vs −23.11 dBFS · YIN F0=−0.014 st · +75.8 MiB · Mode 3 ref2va +1.06 dB audio.
6. ZERO-REWRITE MOVING PORTALS (SpatialDirector + EditGuider) Untouched prompt feeds both branches (same_prompt=True); Branch B adds edit_pass="edited_only" erasure:
vout = vorig + (scale · M[F, H, W]) · (vedit − vorig)
≥ 30% canvas rule: beats 50-block global self-attention pull → 5.91× L/R contrast (Disco Wipe) + dual Clean / HUD MP4 exports.
7. HONEST BOUNDARIES & NEXT (NO HYPE · TRACK 2 ON DECK) • Reference Dual-Lock (fl2va / ref2va): Clean 24-ch VAE latents (0%–33%) + unsteered tag==0 vision tokens still veto text-only clearing even with ReleaseReferences(0.33). Fix: pre-grade stills or steer visual patches directly (Track 2 ColQwen vision_tokens + face_retain ROS). • 3-slider stacks & facets: Stage 2 preserves subjects (sat 0.32→0.17) yet keeps warm red signs; Next: Path 1A sub-faders + bus-scoped V_r (implicit Path 1B cosine routing falsified <1.1% MSE on CPU).
